notes.title: Enhanced Rewards Update
notes.notes:
We've just released a new major update for Bloomtown! We've just released an update for Bloomtown, chocked full of new items, enhanced quest rewards, improved localisations and much more! Check out the full details of the patch on the discussion forums or at the bottom of this blog. Thanks to everyone's feedback, which helped us find bugs, improve the game, and implement better rewards and items in the game. We appreciate every piece of feedback that you provide, so don't hesitate to take the time to leave a review of Bloomtown on Steam!

If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or share feedback, there are two ways to do it:
[list][*]Through our [url=https://discord.gg/nqQEVK8S89]official Discord server[/url]
[*]Via our [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/90-bloomtown/]customer support website[/url][/list]
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2445990/discussions/0/4843148393997681010/]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/fa534ccf66525c66bbd1c838631c55a62f403c2f.png[/img]

[h2]What can you expect in this patch?[/h2]
We've implemented new enhanced versions of items, enhanced side quest rewards, improved the balance of combat, and lots more. Let's go over some of the most important of these changes in more detail:

[h3]New Items:[/h3][list][*] You'll find 20 enhanced versions of previously seen character equipment, including weapons, armor, and accessories. These will help improve your character's combat abilities more gradually as you progress through the game.[/list]
[h3]Improved quest rewards:[/h3][list][*] When completing side quests, you will notice that the rewards have been improved, offering far greater bonuses. This change increases the benefits of completing side quests, making the compensation more tempting.[/list]
[h3]Improved combat balancing:[/h3][list][*] We've slightly increased spell damage for both allies and enemies. This change improved combat speed, as some enemies were too spongy.[/list]
[h3]Dungeon Crates:[/h3][list][*] We've reduced the number of consumables in crates, but the size of cash rewards and crafting resources has been increased to compensate. This shifts the importance from working with the specific items you are provided in dungeons; now, you have the freedom to craft the tools you require or want with the resources provided.[/list]
[h3]Improved Localisation:[/h3][list][*] Based on the feedback we have received since release, we have made a large number of updates to the various localisations of Bloomtown. You should now find improved texts and more accurate translations in all game versions.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png[/img]

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]
[list][*] Changed the player reward system. Significantly increased rewards for side quests. 
[*] Added over 20 enhanced versions of characters equipment. 
[*] Demons will now transfer more experience during Fusion. 
[*] Changed the balance of combat. 
[*] Reduced the number of consumables in dungeon crates but increased the number of cash rewards and resources for crafting. 
[*] Bugs were fixed in the training room. 
[*] Improved localization for all languages. 
[*] Fixed a delay between messages and choices in the dialogue system. 
[*] The achievements transfer between the demo and the full game now works correctly. 
[*] Fixed a softlock when the player presses some combination on the keyboard or gamepad during cutscenes. 
[*] Fixed some bugs in cutscenes. 
[*] Fixed empty description for starter equipment. 
[*] Fixed issues with the garden when it rains. 
[*] Fixed visual artifacts in the forest battle scene. 
[*] Fixed issue interface "to be" shop. 
[*] Fixed visual bugs in dungeons. 
[*] Fixed a softlock when players interact with the bench at the fair. 
[*] Fixed quest “ask Sam about stones”. 
[*] Fixed the quest with mint 
[*] When creating a new save/overwriting an old one, the new one is now displayed at the top of the list instead of at the bottom 
[*] Fixed a bug with the lottery not working correctly (the limit on the number of participants per day could be reset) 
[*] Removed delays for skip text baubles 
[*] Updated locales [/list]

[h2]List of newly added character equipment[/h2]
[list][*] Melee weapons: [list][*] Wooden Sword II

notes.title: Bloomtown's First Sale, and Content Patch 1.0.24.4 - We 🧡 your feedback

We're happy to announce that Bloomtown is currently on sale until November 25, and you can save 20% off. So, if you were ever on the fence about trying out our beautiful pixel-art JRPG adventure, it's finally time to jump off! Hop over to Bloomtown today and enjoy this grand summer adventure with Emily and her friends! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445990/Bloomtown_A_Different_Story/

[h2]Check out our Accolade Trailer  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png[/img][/h2]

[/h1]

We know you've been wanting to manually save your game and run without holding down that button all the time, so why not read the patch notes below and see what we have implemented!

If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or simply share feedback, there are 2 ways to do it:
[list][*]Through our [url=https://discord.gg/nqQEVK8S89]official Discord server[/url]
[*]Via our [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/90-bloomtown/]customer support website[/url][/list]
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2445990/discussions/0/4843148393997681010/]here[/url].

It's also very important to leave a review on the Steam page of Bloomtown. This lets us know all your thoughts about the game, as well as other players. So don't hesitate to drop by our Steam page and leave one now! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/592f15d456bc2cb2ed1a6548e1652976a6f3f209.png[/img]

Now, let's get into the nitty-gritty of these patch notes!

[*] Added option to toggle running as always on

[*] Added Auto On\Off hints option
[*] Added training fights in velvet room 
[*] Added delay before selecting in dialogs 
[*] Rework art and obstacles in house tree dungeon 
[*] Some improvements in pause menu 
[*] Fixed some cases where the achievement was not given for getting all the other achievements
[*] Fixed steam builds crashing when steam API is not initialized 
[*] Fixed game breaking after loading from battle scene 
[*] Fixed some localization issues 
[*] Fixed statistic on the LVL up screen is not correct 
[*] Strongly improved localization into English 
[*] Reworked and fixed some cut-scenes

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.1 & 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Thank you for all the bug reports and feedback you took the time to send us!
We have already rolled 2 updates since release, as to address issues and implement improvements as fast as we can :)

If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or simply share feedback, there are 2 ways to do it:
[list][*]Through our [url=https://discord.gg/nqQEVK8S89]official Discord server[/url]
[*]Via our [url=https://asmodee.helpshift.com/hc/en/90-bloomtown/]customer support website[/url][/list]
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2445990/discussions/0/4843148393997681010/]here[/url].

[b]You can find the detailed patch notes below![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 1.0.1 – released on September 24th[/h2]

[list][*] Added sprint action now can also be triggered with Right Shift
[*] Added keyboard layout type settings dropdown
[*] Added full support for AZERTY and QWERTY keyboards[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/1aa07a740d46fcab18dd61df2aba2691fef9659c.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 1.0.6 – released on September 25th[/h2]

[h3]Balancing regarding “Miss” issues[/h3]

We have heard your feedback, here are the changes implemented to decrease the number of misses during combat: 
[list][*] emons’ evasion stat has been erased. You can still miss but it would not be because of the monster evading the attack.
[*]Rebalancing of accuracy formula for less misses during combat.[/list]
[h3]Technical fixes[/h3]

[list][*] Fixed: Some controllers & gamepads were not working for Bloomtown.
[*] Fixed: Problems with saves causing an instant crash of the game[/list]
[h3]In-game bug & UI fixes[/h3]

[list][*]Fixed: Reading table bug in Emilly’s house. 
[*]Fixed: Endgame  Spoiler  No possibility for the players to get Hugo to come to Chicago with Emily 
[*]Fixed: Hugo's sidequest  Bug with Bernard the cat interactions timing still showcasing the (you can talk to Bernard until 21.30 and he will remind you of the time you need to come)
[*]Fixed: User interface bug where HP and SP would be mixed up in some item descriptions. 
[*]Fixed: Inability to complete the quest  Spoiler  Bloomtown Mystery
[*]Fixed: Camera restrictions not working properly on Wide and Ultrawide screens
[*]Fixed: Graphical issues on districts (especially on Suburban district)
[*]Fixed: Small issues in cutscenes dialogues
[*]Fixed: Minor issues in some cutscenes
[*]Fixed: Minor issues with some doors in dungeons
[*]Fixed: Wrong post-effects on Suburban district
[*]Fixed: Minor graphical issues with the witches’ doors and other arts on Suburban district[/list]

notes.title: Release date announcement 🎒
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Bloomtowners![/h3]

It's official, we finally have a release date!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8b805179ad60a63d4a27fffd3dd5750ac7daf061.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=EPCGMsk9nHg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Bloomtown will launch on PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5 and Xbox One & Xbox Series on September 24, 2024![/h2]

Play as Emily and her younger brother Chester, who are spending their summer holiday in their grandpa’s seemingly cozy and quiet town. But maybe too quiet—children are vanishing, and nightmares are coming to life... As a 12-year-old adventurer, it’s up to you to uncover the mystery and save Bloomtown from a dark fate!

[i]As a heads-up, if you're in Japan or Korea, Bloomtown will launch on September 26th on Nintendo Switch![/i]

Whether you found out about Bloomtown: A Different Story years ago or just now, we're grateful for all of the support you've shown us. If you can, don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and share the news with your friends, family, community, or even your favorite content creator! 
As an indie team, it means a lot. But regardless of all that, we just can't wait for you to finally be able to play the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png[/img]

And that's it for today's dev log! Our heads are down as we are focused on getting the game ready in time, and in the best possible quality for you - but we will have some events and announcements leading up to launch, so please keep an eye out. 

And if you want to join in on our excitement, you can always find us on [url=https://twitter.com/BloomtownGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/bloomtowngame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/2HXwrHAtKK]Discord[/url]. 

Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam too, if that's your preferred platform, as it offers us incredible support and help. 

Take care until next time, gamers ♡

The Bloomtown Team
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png[/img]
